components.textContent:
If your Army Faction is **CHAOS KNIGHTS,** each unit from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army (see below). The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6 below.

Any Dread abilities that have been selected are active until the end of the battle. You cannot select the same Dread ability more than once, and any duplicated Dread abilities (as a result of randomly selecting them) have no additional effect.
While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1
components.title: N/A - Deathly Terror (Aura)

components.textContent: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability [see above].
components.title: 1 - Despair (Aura)

components.textContent: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.
components.title: 2 - Doom

components.textContent: This model has **Stealth**.
components.title: 3 - Darkness

components.textContent: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
components.title: 4 - Dismay (Aura)

components.textContent: While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
components.title: 5 - Delirium (Aura)

components.textContent: Add 3"to the range of this model’s Aura abilities.
components.title: 6 - Dominion

components.textContent: Where Chaos Knights tread, the skies grow unnaturally dark and the power of the warp permeates the battlefield.
components.title: Lore

components.textContent:
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding **TITANIC** models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:

■ It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
■ It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

If every model in your army has the **CHAOS** keyword, you can include either 1 **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** model or up to 3 **WAR DOG** models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your **WARLORD**, and they cannot be given Enhancements.
Dreadblades stalk the galaxy, carving a path of destruction alongside other forces of Chaos
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Hate-filled Dominion
enhancements.rules: Knight Tyrant model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

enhancements.name: Pterrorshade Rookery
enhancements.rules: Knight Tyrant model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Focus
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Knight Tyrant unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Knight Tyrant</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Intimidating Reminder
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly <k>Knight Tyrant</k> unit has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Knight Tyrant</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Rune-cursed Stronghold
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, when a friendly Knight Tyrant unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Knight Tyrant</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

components.textContent: Friendly Knight Tyrant units’ attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have +1 to the hit roll.
The withering arsenal of cursed weaponry available to a Knight Tyrant is turned with the cruellest focus upon those its scion despises for their weakness of spirit.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Aspect of the Beast
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. At the start of your Command phase, select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Helm
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Octagram of Conjuration
enhancements.rules:
**KNIGHT ABOMINANT** model only. The bearer has the following ability:

**Octagram of Conjuration (Aura):** While a friendly **WAR DOG** model is within 9” of this model, after that **WAR DOG** model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test.

enhancements.name: Throne Tyrannicus
enhancements.rules: **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. In your Command phase, select one other **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** model within 9” of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly **WAR DOG** units, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** model is affected by those Aura abilities as well.

stratagems.name: Feral Arrogance
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Merciless Fusillade
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army, and up to two friendly **WAR DOG** units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those **CHAOS KNIGHTS** units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those **CHAOS KNIGHTS** units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

stratagems.name: Beasthide Manifestation
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Flush the Quarry
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army and up to three friendly **WAR DOG** units within 6" of that **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those **WAR DOG** units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Volleys
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Goaded Beast
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6"

components.textContent:
If a **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army has an Aura ability that affects friendly **WAR DOG** units, while two or more friendly **WAR DOG** models are within range of that **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit’s Aura ability, that **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit is affected by that Aura ability as well.

**Example:** *Two friendly War Dog models are within 9” of a Knight Desecrator when it is selected to shoot. As a result, the Knight Desecrator’s Taskmaster ability also affects itself, even though it does not have the War Dog keyword, so each time that Knight Desecrator makes a ranged attack, Hit rolls of 1 are re‑rolled.*

By bending their tyrannical will upon their War Dog underlings, the masters of the hunt goad them to provide a constant stream of sensor data. This influx of supplementary targeting, prey‑seeking and omnisensory analysis enhances the scions’ ability to hunt alongside their snarling ironclad hounds.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enhancements.rules: **WAR DOG** model only. While a friendly **WAR DOG** model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Loping Predator
enhancements.rules: **WAR DOG** model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

enhancements.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knights
enhancements.rules: **WAR DOG** model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer’s Mantle
enhancements.rules: **WAR DOG** model only. The bearer has the Super-heavy Walker ability.

stratagems.name: Vox-Howl
stratagems.whenRules: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **WAR DOG CHARACTER** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly **WAR DOG** unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Hungry for Combat
stratagems.whenRules: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: Two or more **WAR DOG** units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those **WAR DOG** units. Until the end of the phase, models in those **WAR DOG** units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those **WAR DOG** units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Cunning Hunter
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **WAR DOG** unit from your army Falls Back
stratagems.targetRules: That **WAR DOG** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Animalistic Rage
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a **WAR DOG** unit from your army that has not been **selected to attack** this phase is destroyed.
stratagems.targetRules: That **WAR DOG** unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.

stratagems.name: Harrying Hounds
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetRules: One **WAR DOG** unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling Pack
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **WAR DOG** unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

components.textContent: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a **WAR DOG** model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that unit is visible to the attacking model, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.
Once War Dogs have singled out a victim, they target it relentlessly until it is dragged down and torn apart.
components.title: Lore

bulletPoints.text:
While using the Houndpack Lance Detachment, the following rules apply:

■ Your army must include three or more **WAR DOG** units.
■ **WAR DOG** units from your army have the **BATTLELINE** keyword.
■ When mustering your army, select three **WAR DOG** units from your army. Until the end of the battle, those units have the **CHARACTER** keyword.*

***Designer’s Note:** *This means that the selected units can be given Enhancements and one of them can be selected as your* **WARLORD.**

enhancements.name: Snarling Rivalry (Upgrade)
enhancements.rules: <k>Executioner</k> unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have <k>[Ignores Cover]</k>.

enhancements.name: Soul-spoor Auspicator (Upgrade)
enhancements.rules: Huntsman unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

stratagems.name: Insensate Bloodthirst
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly <k>War Dog</k> unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>War Dog</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Leash of the Masters
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly <k>WAR DOG</k> unit has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>War Dog</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: Stalking Focus
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly War Dog unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>War Dog</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Ranged attacks that target your unit have ‑1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

components.textContent: (Once per battle round, per army) In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly War Dog unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range. This detachment has the War Dogs tag and cannot be taken with another War Dogs detachment.
The corrupted pilots of War Dog suits despise fear and cowardice in the foe almost as much as they revel in hunting such prey and betraying their hiding places.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Cruel Lashmaster (Aura)
enhancements.rules: Chaos Knights model only. While a friendly Damned unit is within 6" of this model, when that unit is selected to make a normal/advance/fall‑back move that unit has +2" M until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Iconoclast Idol (Aura)
enhancements.rules: Chaos Knights model only. While a friendly Damned unit is within 6" of this model, when you target that unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is ‑1 CP.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Masters!
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, when a friendly Chaos Knights unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle.
  • Friendly Damned units’ attacks that target a marked unit have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: Coursing Thralls
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly <k>Damned</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted:
  • While a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Dark Sacrifice
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly <k>Damned</k> unit (excluding <k>Accursed Cultists</k> units) within 9" of a friendly <k>Chaos Knights</k> model.
stratagems.effectRules:
Select one Chaos Knights model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3:
  • Your Damned unit suffers that number of mortal wounds.
  • That Chaos Knights model heals that number of wounds.

components.textContent:
• You can include Damned units in your army (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines). The combined points cost of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
  • Friendly Damned units can re‑roll leadership rolls.
Devoted mortal thralls flock to fight in the titanic shadow of their mechanical idols with chanted prayers and brayed challenges.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the **[ASSAULT]** ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

enhancements.name: Blasphemous Engine
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Malefic Surge, you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Knight Diabolus
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the **[LANCE]** ability

stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis
stratagems.whenRules: End of any phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that is not Empowered.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Corrupting Taint
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase, just after a **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Unleash Balefire
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Warp Vision
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Bulwark
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

components.textContent: Calling upon heretical - often supernatural - powers, these Knights are infused with strange and terrible might.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the **[ASSAULT]** ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12” of this model with a **stratagem**, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Spiteful Demise
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after a **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.

stratagems.name: Runes of Disdain
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is **TITANIC,** you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Trophy Hunter
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just before a **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army consolidates.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Crushed Like Vermin
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army ends a Normal move.
stratagems.targetRules: That **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES)** that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

components.textContent: Improve the Objective Control characteristic of **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** models from your army by 2. In addition, once per battle round, if your **WARLORD** is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.
Every one of these egomaniacal warriors seeks to claim all the battlefield glory for themselves, at any cost.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

enhancements.name: Nightmare’s Master
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Tyrant’s Shadow
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is within range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model from your army.

enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model only. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Pterrorshades
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Roll six D6. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Disdain for the Weak
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

stratagems.name: A Long Leash
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ABHORRENT** model from your army and up to two friendly **WAR DOG** units.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the start of your next Command phase, those **WAR DOG** units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your **ABHORRENT** unit has.

stratagems.name: Imperious Advance
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: Up to two **WAR DOG** units from your army or one **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

stratagems.name: Storm of Darkness
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules:
• Your unit has **Stealth**.
• Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to **hit rolls**.

components.textContent: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting one or more Dread abilities to be active for your army, you can select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (this additional Dread ability cannot be randomly selected).
Steeped in the dark powers of the warp, bred into bloodlines who make a tradition of cruelty and a virtue of malice, these merciless warriors delight in spreading fear and dismay.
components.title: Lore
